_about: Public display labels for Cinderhaven's trade partners. The dataset keeps the real names (seed_config.py, Postgres); every public surface (blog posts, /work pages, tool UIs) shows the label instead whenever a Cinderhaven dollar figure is in the same sentence, table row, chart, or card. A real name stays only for the retailer's own published rule, code, fee, or window with no Cinderhaven dollar figure beside it. Decided 2026-11-05 (lailara-website DECISIONS). Vendored to every tool repo by scripts/refresh_canonical.py; scripts/check_retailer_labels.py enforces it on text.
